
# 样本基本信息


```{r spl-msg}
data_group <- read.xlsx(head_path, sheet = 2)

if(sum(colnames(data_group) == '样本分组') > 1) {
  sum_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '样本数量'], na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '实验检测'], na.rm = T)
} else {
  sum_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '样本数量', -1])), na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '实验检测', -1])), na.rm = T)
} 

str <- glue::glue(
  "共收到客户提供的{sum_spl}例{spl_name}样本，实际检测{rel_spl}例{spl_name}样本。",
  sum_spl=sum_spl,
  spl_name=l.a$spl_name,
  rel_spl=rel_spl
  )

pander(str)
```


```{r spl-tab, position = "H", tab.cap="样本信息表", out.width="100%"}
n_col <- ncol(data_group)
kable(data_group)
```

*注：①样本收到后，立即保存在-80℃低温冰箱中，直至实验检测；②为了更好地进行实验，对样本进行了重新编号，详细见“Table S0-样本编号对应表”（若未重新编号则无该表）。*

### 代谢物提取

```{r extract}
## extract method based on sample type
extract <- read.xlsx(head_path, sheet = grep(l.a$spl_type, excel_sheets(head_path)))
if(!l.a$has_qc) extract <- extract[1:nrow(extract)-1]

# hard-remove GC-MS pretreatment block if present
steps_col <- extract[[1]]
gc_start <- which(grepl("^\\s*GC-?MS", steps_col, ignore.case = TRUE))
if (length(gc_start) > 0) {
  # remove from GC-MS row up to just before the next LC-MS row (if any)
  next_lc <- which(seq_along(steps_col) > gc_start[1] & grepl("^\\s*LC-?MS", steps_col, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (length(next_lc) > 0) {
    rm_to <- next_lc[1] - 1
  } else {
    rm_to <- nrow(extract)
  }
  idx_rm <- seq(gc_start[1], rm_to)
  extract <- extract[-idx_rm, , drop = FALSE]
}

# keep only the single text column as '样品前处理步骤'
text_col <- which.max(sapply(extract, function(x) sum(nchar(as.character(x)), na.rm = TRUE)))
extract <- extract[, text_col, drop = FALSE]
colnames(extract) <- c("样品前处理步骤")
extract <- extract[!is.na(extract[[1]]) & trimws(extract[[1]]) != "", , drop = FALSE]

rownames(extract) <- NULL
kbl(extract, "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = "样品前处理步骤", row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options="striped") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "15cm")
```
